item.mod-stella-spells.spark_shot.effect: Hits the mob for 3 magic damage and sets it on fire for 6 seconds.
Hits the mob for %1$s magic damage and sets it on fire for %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.frostbind.effect: Slows the mob with Slowness II for 8 seconds and adds a Chill; a fourth Chill freezes it solid.
item.mod-stella-spells.frostbind.effect_: Slows the mob with Slowness %8$s for %4$s and adds a Chill; a fourth Chill freezes it solid.
item.mod-stella-spells.gale_step.effect: Launches you forward on a gust, then lets you drift down with Slow Falling for 2 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.gale_step.effect_: Launches you forward on a gust, then lets you drift down with Slow Falling for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.stoneguard.effect: Hardens your skin with Resistance I for 30 minutes.
Hardens your skin with Resistance %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.static_lash.effec: Shocks the mob for 3 damage, then arcs 3 damage to up to two more hostiles within 4 blocks. Soaked mobs take half again as much.
Shocks the mob for %1$s damage, then arcs %1$s damage to up to %7$s more hostiles within %6$s blocks. Soaked mobs take half again as much.
item.mod-stella-spells.briar_snare.effec: Roots the mob in thorns with Slowness IV for 8 seconds.
Roots the mob in thorns with Slowness %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.tidal_push.effect: Knocks the mob away from you with a wave and leaves it Soaked.
item.mod-stella-spells.slimebound.effect: Grants Jump Boost II and Slow Falling for 30 minutes.
Grants Jump Boost %8$s and Slow Falling for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.chainstorm.effect: Calls lightning that jumps from mob to mob: it strikes the hostile nearest the spot you look at, then leaps to the nearest unstruck hostile within 5 blocks, up to 5 strikes, 6 damage each.
Calls lightning that jumps from mob to mob: up to %7$s hostiles within %6$s blocks of the spot you look at, %1$s damage each. Soaked mobs take half again as much.
item.mod-stella-spells.riftwalk.effect: Teleports you onto the spot you look at, or in front of the wall you look at; never into walls, water or mobs.
item.mod-stella-spells.phoenix_mantle.ef: Grants Fire Resistance for 30 minutes and heals you for 2 hearts.
Grants Fire Resistance for %4$s and heals you for %2$s health.
item.mod-stella-spells.life_bloom.effect: Heals you for 4 hearts and grants Regeneration I for 15 seconds.
Heals you for %2$s health and grants Regeneration %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.void_well.effect: Pulls every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot toward it and slows them with Slowness II for 6 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.void_well.effect_: Pulls every hostile within %6$s blocks of the spot toward it and slows them with Slowness %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.wardens_roar.effe: Deals 6 damage to every hostile within 5 blocks of you and throws them back.
Deals %1$s damage to every hostile within %6$s blocks of you and throws them back.
item.mod-stella-spells.aegis_of_the_deep: Grants Absorption II and Resistance I for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.wither_seal.effec: Seals the mob with Wither II for 15 seconds.
Seals the mob with Wither %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.time_lock.effect: Slows every hostile within 5 blocks of the spot with Slowness II for 10 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.time_lock.effect_: Slows every hostile within %6$s blocks of the spot with Slowness %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.dragonfall.effect: Calls down a dragon strike for 10 magic damage to every hostile within 3 blocks of the spot.
Calls down a dragon strike for %1$s magic damage to every hostile within %6$s blocks of the spot.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.hosti: Target: the hostile mob you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.block: Target: the block you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.target.safe_: Target: the spot you look at, up to 16 blocks away
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.hostile: Use: hold it and right-click while aiming at the mob
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.block: Use: hold it and right-click while aiming at the ground
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.use.safe_tel: Use: hold it, look at where you want to stand, and right-click
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.scroll: Single use: the scroll crumbles when the spell lands
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.imbued: Imbued: %s, cast on hit at half strength
item.mod-stella-spells.ice_lance.effect: Hurls a lance of ice through the mob and on for 16 blocks: every hostile on its line takes 5 damage and freezes solid for 14 seconds, and the lance leaves a trail of snow mist.
item.mod-stella-spells.ice_lance.effect_: Hurls a lance of ice through the mob and on for %6$s blocks: every hostile on its line takes %1$s damage and freezes solid for %4$s, and the lance leaves a trail of snow mist.
item.mod-stella-spells.soul_siphon.effec: Drains 4 health from the mob and gives it to you.
Drains %1$s health from the mob and gives it to you.
item.mod-stella-spells.venom_dart.effect: Stings the mob for 2 damage and poisons it with Poison II for 15 seconds.
Stings the mob for %1$s damage and poisons it with Poison %8$s for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.sapping_hex.effec: Weakness II on every hostile within 6 blocks, and Strength II on you: 9 seconds for each hostile hexed, up to 45.
Weakness %8$s on every hostile within %6$s blocks, and Strength %9$s on you: %4$s for each hostile hexed, up to %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.blinding_flash.ef: Blinds the mob for 15 seconds and Marks it for 30: it glows and takes more damage from players.
Blinds the mob for %4$s and Marks it for %5$s: it glows and takes more damage from players.
item.mod-stella-spells.ember_brand.effec: Brands the mob for 2 damage, sets it burning for 30 seconds, and Scorches it so it heals half as much. A Soaked mob only dries off.
Brands the mob for %1$s damage, sets it burning for %4$s, and Scorches it so it heals half as much. A Soaked mob only dries off.
item.mod-stella-spells.quicksilver.effec: Gives you Speed II for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.tide_lungs.effect: Lets you breathe underwater for 30 minutes and swim fast for 30 minutes.
Lets you breathe underwater for %4$s and swim fast for %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.berserk.effect: Gives you Strength II for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.haste_rune.effect: Gives you Haste II for 30 minutes.
item.mod-stella-spells.shadow_veil.effec: Makes you invisible for 30 minutes. The first blow you strike breaks the veil: it deals double damage and stops its victim dead for 2 seconds.
Makes you invisible for %4$s. The first blow you strike breaks the veil: it deals double damage and stops its victim dead for %5$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.sanctuary.effect: Raises a holy zone of 6 blocks where you stand for 30 seconds: players in it regenerate, and undead in it take 3 damage every second.
item.mod-stella-spells.sanctuary.effect_: Raises a holy zone of %6$s blocks where you stand for %4$s: players in it regenerate, and undead in it take %1$s damage every second.
item.mod-stella-spells.purify.effect: Clears every harmful effect from you and each player within 6 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.purify.effect_liv: Clears every harmful effect from you and each player within %6$s blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.frost_nova.effect: Deals 3 damage to hostiles within 5 blocks of you, slows them with Slowness IV for 6 seconds, and adds a Chill.
Deals %1$s damage to hostiles within %6$s blocks of you, slows them with Slowness %8$s for %4$s, and adds a Chill.
item.mod-stella-spells.earthspike.effect: Throws hostiles within 3 blocks of the spot into the air for 4 damage.
Throws hostiles within %6$s blocks of the spot into the air for %1$s damage.
item.mod-stella-spells.plague_cloud.effe: Leaves a cloud of Poison at the spot for 15 seconds.
Leaves a cloud of Poison at the spot for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.flame_ring.effect: Wreathes you in a burning aura for 5 minutes: each second, hostiles within 5 blocks take 3 damage and catch fire. You never burn.
Wreathes you in a burning aura for %4$s: each second, hostiles within %6$s blocks take %1$s damage and catch fire. You never burn.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.fizzle: Your head spins and the spell fizzles.
item.mod-stella-spells.scroll_book.effec: Holds 9 different scrolls. Use it to open.
item.mod-stella-spells.return_scroll.eff: Read it to return to your respawn point in the Overworld.
item.mod-stella-spells.gravity.effect: Hostiles within 6 blocks are slowed and can jump only half as high for 16 seconds.
item.mod-stella-spells.gravity.effect_li: Hostiles within %6$s blocks are slowed and can jump only half as high for %4$s.
item.mod-stella-spells.bulwark_hymn.effe: Absorption II for 30 minutes on you and every ally within 8 blocks: players, villagers, golems and tamed pets.
Absorption %8$s for %4$s on you and every ally within %6$s blocks: players, villagers, golems and tamed pets.
item.mod-stella-spells.tailwind.effect: Speed II for 30 minutes on you and every ally within 8 blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.tailwind.effect_l: Speed %8$s for %4$s on you and every ally within %6$s blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.battle_hymn.effec: Strength I for 30 minutes on you and every ally within 8 blocks.
Strength %8$s for %4$s on you and every ally within %6$s blocks.
item.mod-stella-spells.summon_skeleton.e: Raises a skeleton that serves you. Cast again to call it to your side. Use it to open its gear.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.awaken.no_pl: Only a player can awaken a spellbook.
spellbook.mod-stella-spells.awaken.no_bo: Hold a spellbook in your main hand.
